title: 空パレット付き倉庫ラック一区画
description: 倉庫・物流施設に置く一連のパレットラック一区画。四本の貫通スロット付き支柱、接地用足板、左右の水平材と斜材、三段の前後クロスビームと接続金具、奥行方向のパレット受け、原作の空の木製ブロックパレット三枚を備えます。パレットは下段左に一枚、中段に二枚で、上段は空です。収納物やロゴはなく、全体で一モデルです。荷重計算、固定工事、構造安全性・搬送動作は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.860 × 2.998 × 1.204 m、26,852三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: One complete pallet-racking bay for warehouse and distribution scenes. It has four through-slotted uprights and footplates, horizontal/diagonal side-frame bracing, three pairs of connected front/rear crossbeams, depthwise pallet supports, and three original empty timber block pallets. One pallet is on the lower left, two are on the middle level, and the upper level is empty. There are no goods or logos; the entire bay counts as one model. Load ratings, anchoring works, structural safety and handling behavior are not validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.860 × 2.998 × 1.204 m; 26,852 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
